context: atlas #2 target promoted by the weather kill (weather-alpha-v2-verdict.md). Structural advantages over weather: the settlement variable is embargoed until release (no intraday-realization handicap - the T-1d information field is flat), and ALFRED vintages + archived nowcasts give legitimate point-in-time backtesting. Power verified before registration: pooled tail-zone release events per fold = 73/85/93 (early/middle/recent), above the 50-event floor.

universe.note: pooled: a release print is ONE event regardless of bracket count; no single release type clears the floor alone and none is claimed alone

data_plan.vintages: ALFRED point-in-time vintages for each settlement series (free API key required - operator action)
data_plan.nowcasts: Cleveland Fed inflation nowcast archive (public history) for CPI/PCE; SPF/consensus where point-in-time archives exist; a nowcast enters the model only with a documented as-of timestamp
data_plan.rule: point-in-time or it does not count; capture forward from adoption for anything without an archive

model_v0: per release type: anchor = latest point-in-time nowcast (or vintage-implied trailing value where no nowcast exists); distribution = anchor plus the walk-forward empirical distribution of anchor-vs-print errors for that release type; bracket probabilities read off that distribution. No fitted parameters beyond the error history itself

families.hypothesis: resting NO on <=5c YES macro brackets where the model tail probability is below threshold beats resting NO on all such brackets
resting NO at 96-99c where the model doubts the favorite bracket by a registered margin beats doing so indiscriminately

gates: identical to weather-alpha-v2: maker economics primary, taker as robustness column; three chronological folds (same boundaries), >=50 independent release events per fold, mean minus two release-clustered SEs above 7 percent with carry, matched market-only baselines with positive incremental lower bound every fold, family FDR then combined suite FDR, day-cluster robustness reported
calibration: walk-forward per release type (middle fits on early, recent fits on early+middle), pre-committed bins as in weather-alpha-v2; early in-fit and excluded from the kill condition
kill_condition: if the calibrated model shows no monotone out-of-fold separation of realized tail rates across the threshold ladder (middle+recent), macro modeling closes; the program then has no model lane and the week-10 checkpoint proceeds on the structural forward test alone
amendment_cap: one structural amendment maximum after first execution, change-logged; a second failure is a verdict, not a bug (weather lesson)
